module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input [7:0] d,
  input reset,
  output reg [7:0] q
);

always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  if (!rst_n) begin
    q <= 8'b0;
  end
  else if (clk) begin
    q <= reset[12:9] << (d[0] ? 12 : 8);
  end
  else begin
    q <= d + (reset[0] ? q + 12'b0 : d + 12'b0);
  end
end

endmodule
